properties.title: Execute a security incident response procedure

properties.name: Enforce application authorization
properties.definition: Check permissions for protected actions and resources.

properties.name: Configure and verify network connectivity
properties.definition: Configure a bounded network connection and check addressing, routing and name resolution.

properties.name: Maintain configuration records
properties.definition: Keep infrastructure configuration and change records aligned with the deployed state.

properties.name: Monitor service health
properties.definition: Collect and interpret service measurements and alerts against agreed operating limits.

properties.name: Apply infrastructure hardening and updates
properties.definition: Apply approved secure configuration and updates, then check operation and protection.

properties.name: Analyse information security risks
properties.definition: Identify a bounded security risk, its affected assets and a justified treatment proposal.

properties.name: Select and verify security controls
properties.definition: Choose controls for a stated threat or requirement and check their intended protection.

properties.name: Configure identity and access controls
properties.definition: Configure and test authentication or authorization rules against an agreed access policy.

properties.name: Investigate security alerts
properties.definition: Interpret a security alert and supporting records to decide a justified next action.

properties.name: Execute a security incident response procedure
properties.definition: Apply an agreed incident procedure while preserving records and verifying containment.

properties.name: Assess technical vulnerabilities
properties.definition: Identify and validate findings in an authorized assessment scope and explain their impact.

properties.name: Verify vulnerability remediation
properties.definition: Apply or coordinate an agreed remedy and check that the relevant finding is resolved.

properties.name: Document security control assurance
properties.definition: Connect a security requirement, control and check result in a reviewable assurance record.

properties.name: Communicate security recommendations
properties.definition: Explain a security finding, decision or control to the audience responsible for action.

properties.name: Maintain security policy procedures
properties.definition: Keep an agreed security policy and its operating procedures consistent with the stated scope.
